name: Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator

exam.notes: 100 minutes per the certification page (seat time may be longer); may include case studies and interactive items. Question count not officially published (40-60 commonly reported). Associate certification renews every 12 months via free online assessment. English update takes effect Oct 28, 2026.

caveats: This captures the upcoming outline effective Oct 28, 2026 (one week after today); until then the live English exam uses the prior version.
